mapper.select: select pr.*,rs.rank_id,rs.ranking,rs.song_id,s.song_name,si.singer_name, ut.tag_id,td.tag_name from ( select p.rank_name,p.user_id,p.rank_id from personal_rank as p left join rank_song as rs on p.rank_id=rs.rank_id left join song as s on s.song_id=rs.song_id left join singer as si on s.singer_id = si.singer_id left join user as u on p.user_id = u.user_id left join user_tags as ut on ut.user_id=u.user_id left join tags_dictionary as td on td.tag_id=ut.tag_id where (p.rank_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or s.song_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or si.singer_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or td.tag_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and p.user_id=#{userId} group by p.rank_id order by p.rank_id limit 20) as pr left join rank_song as rs on pr.rank_id=rs.rank_id left join song as s on s.song_id=rs.song_id left join singer as si on s.singer_id = si.singer_id left join user as u on pr.user_id = u.user_id left join User_Tags as ut on ut.user_id=u.user_id left join tags_dictionary as td on td.tag_id=ut.tag_id order by pr.rank_id,rs.ranking
